why_ai: Screen-only platform and outsourced team work; economy tuning and event production are prime AI targets.
why_clarity: Events recur constantly, but economies are tuned by instinct and costs show months later.
why_digital: Telemetry in, configuration and live content out, sold to studios remotely.

why_ai: Faucet and sink balancing over telemetry is a modelling problem simulation and AI can increasingly handle.
why_clarity: Tuned in spreadsheets by instinct, with inflation compounding invisibly for a quarter.
why_digital: Game telemetry in, configuration values out, all on screen.

why_ai: Agent-based and stock-flow simulation over existing telemetry is software, sold as a product.
why_clarity: A three-month forecast is checkable against actuals using known simulation methods.
why_digital: Telemetry in, forecasts out, entirely in software.

why_ai: Long-horizon causal measurement of engagement is analytics that tooling can automate.
why_clarity: Every event is measured the same way, but the engagement cost arrives months later.
why_digital: Player telemetry in, evaluation reports out.

why_ai: Index construction and alerting over existing game data needs no human judgment at all.
why_clarity: A price index over logged data is a codified, continuously checkable computation.
why_digital: Game data in, indices and alerts out.

why_ai: Event configuration, copy, localisation and validation are repetitive authoring generative AI absorbs.
why_clarity: A permanent production line of similar events with validation passes on each.
why_digital: Content authored, validated and shipped entirely in software.

why_ai: Ticket classification, routing and resolution in many languages is what LLM support agents do.
why_clarity: A continuous stream of mostly repetitive, mechanically resolvable tickets.
why_digital: Tickets and community posts in, responses and alerts out.

why_ai: Dependency mapping and staged rollout of config values are engineering controls software provides.
why_clarity: Blast radius is mappable and change control follows established code-review practice.
why_digital: Configuration data and code, entirely digital.

why_ai: Multi-year cadence choices balancing player and team fatigue are ambiguous strategic calls by product leadership.
why_clarity: Sustainability shows only after years, when the team and player base have thinned.
why_digital: Planning from telemetry and capacity data, all on screen.

why_ai: Explaining balance changes needs a credible human face to an angry community.
why_clarity: No standard for explaining decisions; community reaction shows within days.
why_digital: Data, patch notes and community channels, all online.

why_ai: Overnight design and economy incidents need judgment, though runbooks and routing automate much.
why_clarity: Incidents resolve visibly and fast, but the response is judgment rather than procedure.
why_digital: Dashboards, alerts and configuration changes, entirely remote.
